description: MySQL error 2006 — the connection to the server was lost mid-use, typically because an idle connection timed out or a packet exceeded max_allowed_packet.

title: Can't Connect to Local MySQL Server Through Socket
description: MySQL error 2002 — the client looked for the Unix socket file (usually /var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock) and found nothing listening.
keywords: can't connect to local mysql server through socket

title: MySQL Lock Wait Timeout Exceeded
description: MySQL error 1205 — a transaction waited longer than innodb_lock_wait_timeout for row locks held by another transaction and gave up.

title: MySQL Incorrect String Value
description: MySQL error 1366 — an INSERT or UPDATE contained bytes the column's character set cannot store, most famously emoji into a 'utf8' column.

title: PostgreSQL Password Authentication Failed
description: PostgreSQL error 28P01 — 'FATAL: password authentication failed for user'. The server rejected the supplied password for that role.
keywords: password authentication failed for user postgres

title: PostgreSQL Role Does Not Exist
description: PostgreSQL error 28000 — 'FATAL: role "username" does not exist'. The role you tried to connect as has never been created on this cluster.
keywords: fatal role postgres does not exist

title: PostgreSQL Database Does Not Exist
description: PostgreSQL error 3D000 — 'FATAL: database "name" does not exist'. The cluster you reached has no database by that name.

title: PostgreSQL Remaining Connection Slots Are Reserved
description: PostgreSQL error 53300 — 'FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections'. The cluster hit max_connections.

title: Redis NOAUTH Authentication Required
description: The Redis error returned when the server requires a password (requirepass or ACLs) but the client sent commands without authenticating first.

title: Redis MISCONF — Unable to Persist to Disk
description: The Redis error 'MISCONF Redis is configured to save RDB snapshots, but it is currently not able to persist on disk' — writes are blocked until persistence recovers.
keywords: misconf redis is configured to save rdb snapshots
redis unable to persist on disk

title: Redis OOM Command Not Allowed
description: The Redis error 'OOM command not allowed when used memory is greater than maxmemory' — the memory limit is reached and the eviction policy refuses to free space.

title: MongoDB Authentication Failed
description: MongoDB error code 18 — 'Authentication failed' (Atlas reports 'bad auth'). The credentials, authentication database, or mechanism did not match.

title: SQLite Attempt to Write a Readonly Database
description: The SQLite error raised when a write is attempted but the database file — or, just as often, its directory — is not writable by the process.
keywords: attempt to write a readonly database

title: SQLite No Such Table
description: The SQLite error 'no such table: name' — the table does not exist in the database file the connection actually opened, which is often not the file you intended.

title: Nginx bind() Failed — Address Already in Use
description: The startup error 'nginx: [emerg] bind() to 0.0.0.0:80 failed (98: Address already in use)' — another process already owns the port nginx wants.
keywords: nginx bind failed address already in use

title: Nginx Unknown Directive
description: The config-test error 'nginx: [emerg] unknown directive' — a directive is misspelled, belongs to a module that is not loaded, or is not an nginx directive at all.
keywords: nginx directive is not allowed here

title: Nginx Connection Refused While Connecting to Upstream
description: The error-log line 'connect() failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream' — nginx reached the backend host, but nothing was listening. Visitors see a 502.
keywords: connect failed 111 connection refused while connecting to upstream

title: Nginx Upstream Timed Out
description: The error-log line 'upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream' — the backend took longer than nginx was willing to wait. Visitors see a 504.
keywords: upstream timed out while reading response header
nginx timeout while connecting to upstream

title: Nginx No Live Upstreams
description: The error-log line 'no live upstreams while connecting to upstream' — every server in the upstream block is currently marked failed, so nginx has nowhere to send the request.
keywords: no live upstreams while connecting to upstream

title: Nginx Cannot Load Certificate
description: Startup/reload errors like 'nginx: [emerg] cannot load certificate' or 'SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file failed (key values mismatch)' — the TLS files are missing, unreadable, or mismatched.

title: Nginx Too Many Open Files
description: Error-log lines like 'socket() failed (24: Too many open files)' or 'accept4() failed' — nginx hit its file-descriptor limit and is dropping connections.
keywords: socket failed 24 too many open files

title: Nginx Directory Index Forbidden
description: The error-log line 'directory index of "/var/www/html/" is forbidden' — a request hit a directory, no index file matched, and autoindex is off, so nginx returned 403.

title: Nginx Primary Script Unknown (PHP-FPM)
description: The error-log line 'FastCGI sent in stderr: "Primary script unknown"' — PHP-FPM could not find the script nginx asked it to run. Browsers show a bare 'File not found.'
keywords: fastcgi sent in stderr primary script unknown
nginx php docker file not found

title: Nginx Conflicting Server Name
description: The warning 'nginx: [warn] conflicting server name "example.com" on 0.0.0.0:80, ignored' — two server blocks claim the same name, and nginx is silently ignoring one of them.
keywords: nginx warn conflicting server name ignored

title: Nginx Upstream Sent Too Big Header
description: The error-log line 'upstream sent too big header while reading response header from upstream' — the backend's response headers overflowed nginx's buffer. Visitors see a 502.

title: Nginx Permission Denied While Connecting to Upstream
description: The error-log line 'connect() to ... failed (13: Permission denied) while connecting to upstream' — the OS blocked nginx's connection to the backend, classically SELinux.
keywords: nginx permission denied while connecting to upstream

title: Apache AH00558 — Could Not Reliably Determine FQDN
description: The startup message 'AH00558: apache2: Could not reliably determine the server's fully qualified domain name' — Apache has no ServerName and is guessing.
keywords: could not reliably determine the server's fully qualified domain name

title: Apache AH00072 — make_sock: Could Not Bind to Address
description: The startup failure '(98)Address already in use: AH00072: make_sock: could not bind to address [::]:80' — another process holds Apache's port, or Apache is fighting itself.
keywords: make_sock could not bind to address

title: Apache Invalid Command 'RewriteEngine'
description: The error "Invalid command 'RewriteEngine', perhaps misspelled or defined by a module not included in the server configuration" — mod_rewrite (or another module) is not enabled.
keywords: perhaps misspelled or defined by a module not included

title: Apache AH01630 — Client Denied by Server Configuration
description: The error-log line 'AH01630: client denied by server configuration' — an authorization rule (usually Require directives) rejected the request. Visitors see 403 Forbidden.

title: Apache AH00035 — Search Permissions Missing on a Component of the Path
description: The error-log line 'AH00035: access to / denied ... because search permissions are missing on a component of the path' — the Apache user cannot traverse a directory above the docroot.
keywords: search permissions are missing on a component of the path

title: Apache AH00161 — MaxRequestWorkers Reached
description: The warning 'AH00161: server reached MaxRequestWorkers setting, consider raising the MaxRequestWorkers setting' — Apache is out of workers and queueing or refusing requests.

title: Apache AH01071 — Got Error 'Primary Script Unknown' (PHP-FPM)
description: The error-log line 'AH01071: Got error \'Primary script unknown\'' — Apache proxied a request to PHP-FPM, which could not find the script. Browsers show 'File not found.'
keywords: got error primary script unknown apache

title: Apache AH02565 — Certificate and Private Key Do Not Match
description: The startup failure 'AH02565: Certificate and private key ... from ... and ... do not match' — SSLCertificateFile and SSLCertificateKeyFile are not a pair.
keywords: certificate and private key do not match apache

title: Apache AH00898 — Error Reading from Remote Server (mod_proxy)
description: The error-log line 'AH00898: Error reading from remote server' (with AH01102 'error reading status line') — Apache's reverse proxy lost the backend mid-request. Visitors see 502.
keywords: error reading from remote server apache

title: Apache AH00023 — No Space Left on Device (Mutex/Semaphore)
description: The startup failure 'No space left on device: AH00023: Couldn't create the mpm-accept mutex' — usually exhausted semaphores, not an actually full disk.
keywords: no space left on device apache mutex

title: Apache AH00526 — Syntax Error in Configuration
description: The configtest/startup failure 'AH00526: Syntax error on line N of file' — Apache cannot parse the configuration and refuses to start or reload until it is fixed.

title: Apache Threaded MPM vs PHP Module Conflict
description: The error 'Apache is running a threaded MPM, but your PHP Module is not compiled to be threadsafe. You need to recompile PHP.' — mod_php demands the prefork MPM.
keywords: apache is running a threaded mpm but your php module is not compiled to be threadsafe

title: Apache AH01276 — Cannot Serve Directory
description: The error-log line 'AH01276: Cannot serve directory ...: No matching DirectoryIndex ... found, and server-generated directory index forbidden by Options directive' — visitors see 403.
keywords: directory index forbidden by options directive

title: Node.js Cannot Find Module
description: The crash "Error: Cannot find module 'x'" (code MODULE_NOT_FOUND) — Node's resolver could not locate a package or file your code requires or imports.

title: Cannot Use Import Statement Outside a Module
description: The crash "SyntaxError: Cannot use import statement outside a module" — ES-module syntax ran in a CommonJS context, in Node, Jest, or a browser script tag.
keywords: cannot use import statement outside a module

title: Node.js ERR_REQUIRE_ESM
description: The crash 'Error [ERR_REQUIRE_ESM]: require() of ES Module ... not supported' — CommonJS code tried to require() a package that ships only as an ES module.
keywords: require() of es module not supported

title: JavaScript Heap Out of Memory
description: The crash 'FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory' — the Node process hit V8's heap ceiling and aborted.

title: Node.js EADDRINUSE — Address Already in Use
description: The crash 'Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000' — another process (often a previous instance of the same app) already listens on the port.
keywords: listen eaddrinuse address already in use 3000

title: Node.js error:0308010C — Digital Envelope Routines Unsupported
description: The build crash 'Error: error:0308010C:digital envelope routines::unsupported' — Node 17+ (OpenSSL 3) rejects legacy hash usage in older webpack toolchains.

title: node-gyp Build Failed
description: Install failures full of 'gyp ERR! build error' and 'gyp ERR! stack' — a package with native C/C++ code could not compile on your machine.

title: Node.js Unhandled Promise Rejection
description: The crash 'Error [ERR_UNHANDLED_REJECTION]: This error originated either by throwing inside of an async function without a catch block...' — a rejected promise had no handler, and Node 15+ exits.

title: npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
description: The npm failure 'npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE, npm ERR! errno 1' — the package.json script npm ran exited with a non-zero code. npm is the messenger, not the culprit.

title: npm ERR! ENOENT — Could Not Read package.json
description: The failure 'npm ERR! code ENOENT ... Could not read package.json' — npm ran in a directory that has no package.json to read.
keywords: enoent no such file or directory open package.json

title: Node.js UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY
description: TLS failures like 'npm ERR! UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY' or fetch failing with 'unable to get local issuer certificate' — Node cannot verify the server's certificate chain, typically behind a corporate proxy.
keywords: unable to get local issuer certificate
self signed certificate in certificate chain

title: Maximum Call Stack Size Exceeded
description: The crash 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded' — function calls nested deeper than the stack allows, almost always runaway recursion.

title: Python error: externally-managed-environment
description: pip is protecting a Python installation managed by your operating system or package manager. Choose a virtual environment for project libraries or pipx for command-line applications.

title: Python ImportError: Attempted Relative Import
description: The crash 'ImportError: attempted relative import with no known parent package' — relative imports only work inside a package, and this file was run as a plain script.
keywords: attempted relative import with no known parent package

title: python: command not found
description: Shell errors 'python: command not found' or Windows opening the Microsoft Store — the python command is missing from PATH, or only python3 exists.
keywords: python was not found run without arguments

title: Python UnicodeDecodeError
description: The crash "UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x.. in position .." — bytes were decoded with the wrong encoding, or binary data was opened as text.

title: AttributeError: 'NoneType' Object Has No Attribute
description: The most common Python traceback — a variable is None where code expected a real object, usually because some earlier call returned None.

title: Python RecursionError: Maximum Recursion Depth Exceeded
description: The crash 'RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded' — function calls nested past Python's limit (default 1000), almost always runaway recursion.

title: Python IndentationError
description: Crashes like 'IndentationError: unexpected indent', 'expected an indented block', and 'unindent does not match any outer indentation level' — whitespace that Python cannot parse as structure.
keywords: unindent does not match any outer indentation level

title: pip: TLS/SSL Module Not Available
description: The failure 'pip is configured with locations that require TLS/SSL, however the ssl module in Python is not available' — this Python was built without OpenSSL support.
keywords: ssl module in python is not available

title: Python: No Module Named pip
description: The failure 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named pip' (or '/usr/bin/python3: No module named pip') — this interpreter has no pip installed at all.

title: error: Microsoft Visual C++ 14.0 or Greater Is Required
description: The pip build failure 'error: Microsoft Visual C++ 14.0 or greater is required. Get it with Microsoft C++ Build Tools' — a package needs compiling and Windows has no compiler.
keywords: microsoft visual c++ 14.0 or greater is required

title: venv Activate: Running Scripts Is Disabled on This System
description: The PowerShell failure 'Activate.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled on this system' — Windows' execution policy blocks the venv activation script.
keywords: activate.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled
running scripts is disabled on this system

title: Python SSLCertVerificationError — Certificate Verify Failed
description: The failure 'ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate' in requests, urllib, or pip.
keywords: unable to get local issuer certificate python

title: Cloudflare Error 520 — Web Server Returns an Unknown Error
description: Cloudflare reached the origin server, but the response was empty, malformed, or cut off — something Cloudflare could not interpret as valid HTTP.
keywords: web server returns an unknown error

title: Cloudflare Error 521 — Web Server Is Down
description: Cloudflare tried to connect to the origin server and the connection was actively refused — nothing is accepting connections on the origin's port.

title: Cloudflare Error 522 — Connection Timed Out
description: Cloudflare's attempt to open a TCP connection to the origin produced no answer at all within the timeout — packets are being dropped, or the origin is too overloaded to accept.

title: Cloudflare Error 523 — Origin Is Unreachable
description: Cloudflare has no network route to the origin at all — typically because the DNS record points at a private, wrong, or no-longer-routed IP address.

title: Cloudflare Error 524 — A Timeout Occurred
description: Cloudflare connected to the origin and delivered the request, but the origin did not complete an HTTP response within 100 seconds — long jobs and slow queries are the usual story.

title: Cloudflare Error 525 — SSL Handshake Failed
description: Cloudflare tried to establish a TLS connection to the origin (Full or Full-strict SSL mode) and the handshake failed — usually no certificate is being served on port 443.

title: Cloudflare Error 526 — Invalid SSL Certificate
description: Under Full (strict) SSL mode, the origin presented a certificate that failed validation — expired, self-signed, untrusted, or issued for a different hostname.

title: Cloudflare Errors 1006, 1007, 1008 — Access Denied: IP Banned
description: The page 'Access denied: the owner of this website has banned your IP address' — an IP Access Rule on the site explicitly blocks your address or range.
keywords: owner of this website has banned your ip address

title: Cloudflare Error 1015 — You Are Being Rate Limited
description: The request tripped a Rate Limiting rule configured by the site's owner — too many requests from your IP inside the rule's time window.

title: Cloudflare Error 1016 — Origin DNS Error
description: Cloudflare could not resolve the origin's address: the DNS record behind the proxy points at a hostname that does not resolve — a broken CNAME target is the classic cause.

title: Cloudflare Error 1020 — Access Denied
description: The request matched a firewall or WAF rule on the site — country, network, user-agent, path, or bot-score conditions the owner configured (or a managed rule).

title: Cloudflare Redirect Loop (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS)
description: The browser reports ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS on a site behind Cloudflare — almost always Flexible SSL mode fighting an origin that redirects HTTP to HTTPS.

title: SSL Certificates on the Top 1,000 Websites: 2026 Survey
description: Original data: certificate lifetimes, issuer share, TLS versions and key types across the top 1,000 sites, six months after the 200-day limit.

title: Embeddable Badges
description: Free static SVG badges for your README or site that link to an SSL, DNS, or security headers check of your domain.

title: Privacy Policy
description: What duckTyped and DTMonitor collect, who else sees it, and how long it is kept.
